mapper.sql: id, memory_id, user_id, analysis_id, sentence_id, evidence_type, dedup_key, original_text, corrected_text, confidence, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_evidence (memory_id, user_id, analysis_id, sentence_id, evidence_type, dedup_key, original_text, corrected_text, confidence, created_at) VALUES (#{memoryId}, #{userId}, #{analysisId}, #{sentenceId}, #{evidenceType}, #{dedupKey}, #{originalText}, #{correctedText}, #{confidence}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM memory_evidence WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId} AND evidence_type = #{evidenceType} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memory_evidence WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_id = #{analysisId}
